description.zh:
数据库账号。
> 此参数不填写时，默认返回所有数据库账号信息。
description.en:
The name of the database account.

> If you omit this parameter, information about all database accounts is returned.

description.zh:
账号类型，不填写时默认查询所有类型的账号信息。取值说明：
- **Normal**：普通账号。
- **Super**：高权限账号。
description.en:
The account type. By default, accounts of all types are returned. Valid values:

- **Normal**: a standard account.

- **Super**: a privileged account.

description.zh:
数仓版集群ID。
>您可以调用[DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~)接口查看目标地域下所有数仓版集群的集群ID。
description.en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster.

> You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters in a specific region.

description.zh:
标签键。
> 您可以调用[TagResources](~~179253~~)接口为目标集群创建标签。
description.en:
The key of the tag.

> You can call the [TagResources](~~179253~~) operation to create a tag for a cluster.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adb describe-accounts --db-cluster-id amv-bp11q28kvl6880000 --account-name test_accout --tags Value=low_env Key=AnalyticDB_IO_UTIL --account-type Super --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun adb DescribeAccounts --region cn-hangzhou --Tags.1.Value low_env --DBClusterId 'amv-bp11q28kvl6880000' --Tags.1.Key AnalyticDB_IO_UTIL --AccountType Super --AccountName test_accout
